derivation: feminine of a presumed derivative of G4253 (πρό) as noun;
def: the prow, i.e. forward part of a vessel

occurrences.text: And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.
